scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n api,worker,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @ofd/api" "npm run dev -w @ofd/worker" "npm run dev -w @ofd/web"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ofd/api
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @ofd/worker
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @ofd/domain && npm run build -w @ofd/db && npm run build -w @ofd/integrations
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @ofd/api && npm run build -w @ofd/worker && npm run build -w @ofd/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck:workspaces
scripts.test: npm run test:platform && npm run build:packages && npm run test:workspaces
scripts.test:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
